title: Pin mixed explicit/local sends and superseded sender retry refusal in public tests
outcome: Public mailbox tests cover mixed bound/unbound native routing and the exact prior-sender refusal contract.
acceptance: Public bare local sends succeed both ways between one unbound and one explicitly bound root, with exact native read/ACK ownership and no domain intent.
Committed and unknown-outcome retry tests after automatic sender supersession require the documented409 prior-sender refusal and unchanged retained intent/message state.
